item.title: docs: tracker coherence fixes (README status, ruleset settings, capture backlog, LOT-167)
item.body:
Direct-PR: tracker coherence fixes

**Problem.** The coherence report of 2026-10-28 found stale docs: README "Where we are" counts (65 lots, 23 of 55 done), AGENTS §8 ruleset line silent on `strict=false` and auto-merge, `scripts/configure-repo.sh` not setting `allow_auto_merge`, new capture issues (#272-#278) missing from the capture backlog, and FEAT-003 without an implementing lot.

**Cause.** The settings changed on 2026-10-28 and the counts were written on 2026-10-27; the lot for the `PageNavigation` exactness flag was never created.

**Change.** README counts from LOTS.md and the lot issues (146 lots, 32 of 64 engine lots done); AGENTS §8 ruleset line; `configure-repo.sh` sets `allow_auto_merge=true` (not run); LOTS.md capture list gains #272-#278 and drops #116 (closed, covered by #121); new row LOT-167 (issue #279) linked from FEATURES.md FEAT-003. `scripts/check-lot-deps.py`: 147 lots, 0 violations. Docs only, no tests.

@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+# LOT-167 — PageNavigation exactness flag (honest list paging)
+
+- **Module:** HFRModels
+- **Difficulty / model:** easy (Sonnet → Opus)
+- **Issue:** [#279](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/issues/279) (implements FEAT-003, #147; related bug #104)
+
+## Legacy sources
+None: new behaviour. The legacy app shows the last pager link as the page count; Bybifok reported it as a fake total (#104). LOT-082 ([#100](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/issues/100), done) already shows "Page N" without a total.
+
+## Behaviour
+`PageNavigation` (`Packages/HFRKit/Sources/HFRModels/Lists/PageNavigation.swift`) gains a flag telling whether its page count is **exact** or a **lower bound**. The forum-list pager is a window (`1 … 10 20 … 100 200 … 500`): its last link is a lower bound, while the exact page count of a topic is in its row (`sujetCase4`). Source: HFR-PROTOCOL §7b B1 (shape settled in §6c LOT-022, captures `R04`, `R05a`, `R05b`). The flag is `Codable` and backward compatible (absent means lower bound).
review_comments.body:
** Trivial** · **Data Integrity & Integration** · **Quick win**
Supported by static analysis
Script executed: ```bash git diff --unified=80 71618ab2019dca84f2735bf81ea996e77bce918 9bb22ba14c5618e1626e2b7a16054db79a8ab325 -- docs/lots/LOT-167-page-navigation-exactness.md docs/LOTS.md docs/FEATURES.md printf '\n--- LOT-167 ---\n' sed -n '1,120p' docs/lots/LOT-167-page-navigation-exactness.md printf '\n--- PageNavigation conventions ---\n' rg -n 'decodeIfPresent|CodingKeys|Codable|backward|exact|lower bound' Packages/HFRKit/Sources docs | head -120 ``` Repository: ezzz/HFRnow Length of output: 31050 ---
**Name the flag's key and require a missing-key default.** The Behaviour section says the flag is `Codable` and that absent data means lower bound. It does not name the key or say how decoding must handle a missing key. A non-optional `Bool` in a synthesized `Decodable` conformance throws `keyNotFound` for records written before the flag existed, which conflicts with the stated contract.
📝 Proposed spec edit
```diff -The flag is `Codable` and backward compatible (absent means lower bound). +The flag is `Codable` under a named key, which this section must state. Decoding must use `decodeIfPresent` so an absent key decodes as lower bound. A non-optional `Bool` with synthesized `Decodable` throws `keyNotFound` for records written before the flag existed. ```
